description: Tickets are Nulab Backlog issues (the WMS setup).

fetch.instructions: GET /api/v2/issues/{ticket} and /api/v2/issues/{ticket}/comments with the key from the env var named in config (never print it). reply.post: manual, only on the user's explicit go
